Schedule A (PDF p2) exists and carries a single typed BANNER — the word 'none' in the row-1 'Name of Contributor' cell, with that row's Date, Address and Amount cells all empty. Per CHUNK_BRIEF §7 and ADDENDUM E3 a banner is an ANNOTATION, not an entry: it publishes no row. It sits on printed row 1, which on a filing WITH entries would shift the index by one — here there are no entries to shift, and the whole amount column was crop-proved empty at 700 dpi across all 15 printed rows. 0 rows sum to 0.00 = Box B = both printed footers. notes: ⚠ THIS FILING BINDS THE CHECKLIST DECOY — the registered `utah-checklist-decoy` specimen, caught in the act. PDF p5 is the Elections Division's 'CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST': it recites summary-page labels verbatim ('Balance at Beginning of Period', 'Contributions Received this Period', 'Contributions Received Year to Date', 'Expenditures Made this Period', 'Expenditures Made Year to Date', 'Subtotal before Expenditures', 'Positive balance at Close of Reporting Period') and carries ZERO dollar figures, as TWO staff-signed review copies on one sheet — 'Staff Signature #1' in red ink dated 4/4/22 and 'Staff Signature #2' in magenta dated 4/4/22, with a Website/Network/HOLD box top-right. IT IS NOT A SUMMARY PAGE and was not read as one. The GENUINE Summary Page is PDF p4, located by content. PDF p6 is a WHOLLY BLANK trailing sheet (rowbands returns 0 rules, 0 bars; skew -2.0 deg) — a scan artifact, not a missing page: pdfinfo reports 6 pages and every one is accounted for (cover / Schedule A / Schedule B / Summary / checklist / blank). FORM: modern_boxAF revision **v. 4.20** (footer-printed on all four report sheets) — and it matches the ADDENDUM I3 map exactly, INCLUDING the detail that the close box is UNLETTERED ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)', no G). That is a real difference from the other four 2022 filings in this chunk, which are on an unversioned stock that letters the close box 'G' and adds an In-Kind column; two distinct 2022 revisions therefore circulated. ⚠ MIXED MASTHEADS INSIDE ONE FILING: p1 (cover) and p3 (Schedule B) carry the **Josh Daniels** Clerk/Auditor masthead while p2 (Schedule A) and p4 (Summary) carry **Amelia Powers Gardner** — the previous Clerk/Auditor — all on the same v. 4.20 footer. The v.4.20 cover also differs structurally: it offers only FIVE report types (no 'End-of-Year Report' line), adds an 'Office Use Only' box (Logged / Web / Transmission, all unticked) and a 'Page' field in the footer block, which the filer used — the sheets are foliated 1/2/3/4 and the foliation agrees with the PDF order. REDACTION IS UPSTREAM AND PER-CELL: the county blacked out the whole Address/City/State/Zip strip and the signature block, but LEFT THE PHONE NUMBER IN THE CLEAR on the same page. The redaction bars are the document, not a failed read; nothing behind them was reconstructed, and neither the phone number nor any address was transcribed.
